attempted_claim: With unit edge length, the Schaad minimal 7-fold rhombus fixed-point tiling has non-pure-point diffraction with an absolutely continuous component exceeding the stated Lyapunov-criterion threshold at the named wavevector, and no regular polytopal-window cut-and-project model set is mutually locally derivable from it with finite radius, certified by substitution-matrix and Fourier-cocycle computations.
claim_type: non-pure-point spectral obstruction with non-model-set witness
decisive_failure: The investigation established a concrete algebraic block: the Schaad inflation factor is Pisot, not non-Pisot, and the claimed Fourier-cocycle inputs are absent from the admitted topic. No diffraction computation, Lyapunov bound, or MLD classification could be completed, and the exact Pisot certificate reproduces an already-published Encyclopedia statement so it cannot stand alone as an original finding.
